## Deputies Elections

There have been 8 elections (8 contested) for Deputy held in St Helier No 3 & 4 since 2002.

* * *

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (4 seats), 27th November 2002.

**[Jackie Hilton](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jackie-hilton), [Jacqui Huet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jacqui-huet), [Ben Fox](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ben-fox) and [Guy de Faye](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye) were elected as Deputies of St Helier No 3 & 4 in 2002.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Jackie Hilton](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jackie-hilton)** |  | 1,359 | 62.2% |
| 2 | **[Jacqui Huet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jacqui-huet)** |  | 1,289 | 59% |
| 3 | **[Ben Fox](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ben-fox)** |  | 1,233 | 56.4% |
| 4 | **[Guy de Faye](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye)** |  | 1,191 | 54.5% |
| 5 | [Denise Carroll](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/denise-carroll) |  | 793 | 36.3% |
| 6 | [Imogen Nicholls](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/imogen-nicholls) |  | 724 | 33.1% |
| 7 | [Geraint Jennings](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geraint-jennings) |  | 486 | 22.2% |

2,185 ballots (inc. 14 spoilt papers)

6,507 registered voters

33.6% turnout
